result_text:
Both defects are fixed in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.java`. The `reports` module compiles and its tests pass offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test`, no failures reported).

1. **Group dependency NPE (`getGroupDependencies`, ~line 369):** the reverse-direction branch read `get(key1)`, which is absent in that branch, so it got null. It now reads `get(key2)` and adds to the existing group link. For your example, 3 files from Group 1 to Group 2 plus 2 back gives one Group 1 → Group 2 link labelled 5.

2. **Bogus percentage in "Show more details" (`getFromDependencyCoverageSvg`, ~line 654):** when the referring component has zero counted LOC, the percentage is now 0 instead of dividing by zero. The text shows "0%", and the existing `getPercentageSvg` clamps the bar to a minimum width of 1.

I did not add a regression test. The group-dependency method is private and needs full analysis results to exercise, so a small test would have meant restructuring. I also did not commit.
